meta.name: business-case
meta.description: Develop a business case for an initiative using costs, benefits, risks and evidence. Use when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一项计划的成本、收益与风险整理成能说服赞助方的商业论证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在评审会上为一项计划争取经费或排期,却还没讲清投入产出。
copy.tagline_en: Turn an initiative's costs, benefits, and risks into a clear case sponsors will back.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must justify budget or timeline for an initiative to a sponsor.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你为某个计划梳理成本、收益、风险与证据，产出一份商业论证，用于向赞助人说明预算或时间线。若由 @fde 调用，会复用现有材料，不重新跑流程。
howto.when: 需要为某计划的预算或时间线向赞助人做说明时会触发；由 @fde 调用时直接复用其当前已脱敏材料与范围。

say.text: 帮我为这个计划写一份商业论证，列清成本、收益和风险。
say.note: 会先读任务上下文与方法文档

say.text: 赞助人要批预算或定时间线，帮我整理支撑材料。
say.note: 输出成本、收益、风险与证据

say.text: 按 @fde 现有材料续写，不要重新开始。
say.note: 复用现有材料，不重开流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drafts a business case for an initiative—costs, benefits, risks and evidence—to justify budget or timeline to a sponsor. When called by @fde it reuses the existing sanitized packet instead of restarting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification for an initiative; if invoked by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope rather than restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Draft a business case for this initiative with costs, benefits and risks.
say_en.note: Reads the task context and method first.

say_en.text: The sponsor needs budget or timeline approval—help me assemble the case.
say_en.note: Outputs costs, benefits, risks and evidence.

say_en.text: Continue from @fde's existing materials; don't start over.
